content.title: Ventricular arrhythmias / ICD therapy recommendation
content.recommendation: ICD therapy is recommended to reduce sudden cardiac death
content.indication: Patients with symptomatic heart failure (NYHA Class II–III) and LVEF ≤35% despite optimal medical therapy for >3 months, and at least 6 weeks after myocardial infarction (MI), who are expected to survive for at least 1 year with good functional status.
content.expected_survival_criterion: Expected to survive ≥1 year with good functional status
content.related_notes: NOACs are the preferred drugs (context line above the ICD recommendation).
